svg.title: Night Reco relative to the soil temperature model, before and after a rain day, mean of the events per site and threshold (2, 5 and 10 mm).
svg.desc: Six panels, one per site. X axis: days since the rain day, -3 to 15 (local days). Y axis: night Reco divided by the temperature model, relative to the mean of days −3 to −1 (the night of day d runs from the evening of day d to the morning of day d + 1). Lines: events with at least 2, 5 and 10 mm of rain on day 0; the 5 mm line has a band of ± 1 standard error (SE); a day with fewer than 5 events is not drawn. Values for the 5 mm events (mean ± SE, n events): Anttila: 7 events; day 0: 0.77 ± 0.07 (n = 6); day 7: 1.24 ± 0.30 (n = 2, not drawn); last drawn day 0. Särkisuo: 6 events; day 0: 0.88 ± 0.04 (n = 6); day 7: 1.35 (single event, not drawn); last drawn day 0. Haltiala (Viikki rain): 9 events; day 0: 1.43 ± 0.39 (n = 8); day 7: 0.61 ± 0.05 (n = 2, not drawn); last drawn day 1. Qvidja: 5 events; day 0: 1.01 ± 0.21 (n = 5); day 7: no event; last drawn day 0. Viikki: 4 events; day 0: 1.15 ± 0.20 (n = 4, not drawn); day 7: 0.77 (single event, not drawn); no drawn day. Maktau: 34 events; day 0: 1.19 ± 0.04 (n = 32); day 7: 1.01 ± 0.13 (n = 11); last drawn day 15. Pre-pulse value: 1 (horizontal line).
